settings.pullquote: For many years, we made knitwear for the world's most demanding brands. Now we put our name on it.
settings.body:
Started in 2009 with a single knitting machine in Gujranwala's Small Industrial Estate. Today we run a floor of skilled hands — pattern, knit, link, finish — making knitwear for global brands and, now, our own label.

Stitch Fit exists to bring that craft direct to the man who knows the difference.
settings.closing: Made here. Made by hand. Made to last.
